subject: AUDIT low: shared/styles.css hardcoded hex colors bypassing token system -- 2 easy fixes
body:
DESIGN AUDIT: Hardcoded color values in shared/styles.css not using CSS tokens

Filed by: GD (token consistency audit)
Priority: LOW -- cosmetic, not accessibility

FINDING
Several hex values in shared/styles.css bypass the token system defined in :root.
These work correctly today but create maintenance risk (if brand colors change, these won't update).

SPECIFIC GAPS

1. .answer-key-content h3 (line 557): color: #C8102E;
   Should be: color: var(--accent-red);
   Note: .answer-key-content is the password-protected answer key section.

2. .answer-key-content strong (line 562): color: #C8102E;
   Should be: color: var(--accent-red);

3. border-image gradient (lines 548-553): uses hardcoded #C8102E and #1D42BA
   Cannot use CSS vars in border-image in older Safari. Leave as-is.
   Document the exception in a CSS comment.

FULL COUNT OF HARDCODED HEX IN shared/styles.css (not using var())
- #C8102E: 5 uses (3 in gradient/border-image OK, 2 in h3/strong should be var)
- #1D42BA: 3 uses (2 in gradient OK, 1 possibly needs audit)
- #002D62: 2 uses -- check if these should be var(--accent-navy)
- Various dark bg values (#1A1F36, #0A0E1A, etc.): Arena mode -- defined without tokens (by design)

ACTION ITEMS (low priority)
- Lines 557, 562: change #C8102E to var(--accent-red)
- Review #002D62 uses, convert to var(--accent-navy) if applicable
- Add CSS comment at border-image gradient explaining why var() is not used there

This is a maintenance hygiene item. No visual change expected.
Confirm with GD before making any visual color changes.
